title: Common-stage transport of rational normalized constant-unit coherence
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism such that $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field of $X$ and $Y$. Use the common-stage categories and finite-stage inclusions $j_L$ of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and the rational and common-stage pullback functors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For any finite coefficient stage $L$ and arrow $a:P\to Q$ in the rational constructible category of $Y$ with coefficient field $L$, the common-stage pullback of $j_L(a)$ is heterogeneously equal to $j_L(Lf_L^*(a))$. The endpoint equalities are the prescribed object formulas identifying $Lf_\Omega^*(j_L(P))$ and $Lf_\Omega^*(j_L(Q))$ with $j_L(Lf_L^*(P))$ and $j_L(Lf_L^*(Q))$, respectively.

source.place: Step 1, passage from rational coefficients to the common stage

proof.text: Use the prescribed common-stage pullback map formula on the self-stage representative of the included arrow. The inclusion represents a by the self-transition functor applied to a.

Apply commonStagePullbackComparison_self_unit at the two endpoints. Naturality of the transition unit identifies the conjugated rational pullback map with the self-transition of the rational pullback of a. Passing to ofHom is precisely its stage inclusion. The recorded object equalities give heterogeneous equality.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageDerivedPullback_map_inclusion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω)
    (P Q : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω Y L)
    (a : P ⟶ Q) :
    HEq
      ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).map
        ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion L).map a))
      ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion L).map
        ((rationalDerivedPullback l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).map a))
